mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 83 degrees under overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with an air quality index of 54 and a waning crescent moon overhead.

The City of Verona continues its contract with AECOM for engineering services, with a long history of bi-weekly reports provided to the City Council. Also, seniors can take advantage of the free tri-shaw bike program, which offers scheduled rides on the Military Ridge State Trail.
There is plenty to do, including live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow.
Regarding the weekly safety report, an incident occurred on July 31 where a driver was arrested for O W I after being spotted driving with a flat tire and deactivated taillights.
Enjoy the Really Reese's flavor of the day while the store is open until 10:30 PM, and keep in mind that Kona Ice is also visiting Fireman's Park today from 11 AM until 4 PM.
